name: Snowflake Feature Store and Model Registry
sku: Snowflake Feature Store and Model Registry with model inference, as included in the Snowflake platform. Cortex AI services are not scored.

transform.feature-eng.note: Entities and feature views encapsulate Python or SQL pipelines. Snowflake refreshes managed feature views incrementally on a schedule, ASOF JOIN gives point-in-time correct training sets, and an online store serves features for inference.

serve.ml-serving.note: The Model Registry manages models as Snowflake objects and runs inference either on a virtual warehouse for batch work or on Snowpark Container Services for real-time and GPU endpoints. The registry API is generally available.

presentation.tagline: Feature store and model registry with warehouse and container inference.
